modalLead: Add and edit bookmarks share one centered modal everywhere — Create + New keeps it open and refreshes the grid behind it; Shift+B opens the form from the keyboard. Tag autocomplete stays visible inside the modal, and every view stays in sync after save or delete.

items.text: Shared bookmark form modal — +, Shift+B, Ctrl+Shift+A, and :new open the same centered add/edit shell (#bookmark-form-modal) from the dashboard, Health, Inbox, Config, and search. Inline row edit and the config bookmark editor use the same form (dashboard-inline-edit.js, bookmark-form-modal.css).

Shift+B add bookmark — opens the full new-bookmark form from anywhere on the dashboard when you are not typing in a field; documented on the cheat sheet, in Help tips, and under Config → Keyboard fixed shortcuts (quick-add.js, locales).
Create + New — saves the bookmark, clears the form for the next entry, keeps page/category, and repaints the bookmark grid while the modal stays open (despiteModal in refreshAfterBookmarkMutation()).
Tag autocomplete in the modal — the tags dropdown sits above the form overlay instead of behind it (body.bookmark-form-modal-open .tag-ac-dropdown).

Save and delete without freezing — confirm dialogs stack above the form modal; the grid, config bookmarks list, Health, Inbox, and search refresh after every mutation; inbox promote removes the item after save (dashboard-data.js, dashboard-inline-edit.js).
